plan.goal: Exhaustively validate the Lattice DB marketing and pricing experience, with emphasis on the interactive pricing matrix, add-on pricing logic, tier explainer, feature comparison, FAQ, and mobile usability.
plan.summary: Start on the landing page to verify the primary navigation and pricing CTA, then move to the pricing page for the core matrix flow. On pricing, systematically exercise cell selection, row/column highlighting, sticky quote updates, the calculation expander, add-on checkboxes, tier explainer, and the downstream price breakdown. Finish by checking adjacent informational sections and repeating the critical pricing interactions in a mobile viewport, with special attention to the small-tap-target warnings seen in prescan.
assumptions: The site consists of only two HTML pages: index.html and pricing.html.
The pricing page's matrix cells, add-ons, explainer cells, and FAQ items are all intended to be interactive and stateful.
Header navigation items marked with href="#" may be placeholders rather than fully working destinations, so they should be observed for behavior but not assumed to navigate anywhere meaningful.
The lack of console and network errors in prescan suggests functional issues are more likely to be interaction/state or responsive-usability problems than load failures.
risk_hotspots: pricing.html pricing matrix cells: selected-cell state, row/column highlight persistence, and whether all matrix values are selectable including Contact us cells
pricing.html sticky quote card: correct tier/value update after cell clicks and after switching between distant matrix cells
pricing.html 'How we got this number' expander: disclosure behavior, content visibility, and whether it reflects the selected cell
pricing.html add-on checkboxes: combination pricing, percentage vs flat-fee math, and breakdown card updates
pricing.html tier explainer cells: click-to-highlight mapping and whether tier labels remain synchronized with selected matrix region
pricing.html FAQ and feature comparison sections: expand/collapse or row behaviors if present, plus any unexpected layout breakage
index.html and pricing.html top navigation / CTA tap targets: mobile usability risk due to multiple small-tap-target warnings

phases.title: Landing page orientation
phases.objective: Verify the homepage messaging and the paths into pricing from the landing experience.
key_checks: Confirm the hero narrative, SQL example, and three feature cards render coherently.
Click the primary 'See pricing' CTA and confirm it lands on pricing.html.
Check the top navigation links for expected behavior, especially Pricing versus placeholder links like Docs/Customers/Sign in.
exit_criteria: Pricing page is reached from the landing page via the CTA or nav.
No unexpected navigation errors or broken rendering are observed on the landing page.

phases.title: Core pricing matrix validation
phases.objective: Exercise the main two-axis pricing interaction and verify the page responds correctly to different cell selections.
key_checks: Click representative cells across multiple rows and columns, including a low-price cell, a mid-tier cell, a high-price cell, and at least one 'Contact us' cell.
Verify the selected cell state changes, the correct row and column highlight, and the sticky quote card updates to the selected amount and tier.
Confirm the displayed tier labels correspond to the row band and that switching cells clears or updates prior selection state correctly.
exit_criteria: At least one cell from each major row band has been selected.
The quote card and highlighted matrix state have been observed to update consistently across selections.

phases.title: Pricing explanation and add-ons
phases.objective: Validate the supporting pricing logic around the selected cell and the add-on controls that modify monthly cost.
key_checks: Open the 'How we got this number' expansion and confirm the explanatory content appears and remains tied to the selected cell.
Toggle several add-on checkboxes, mixing percentage and flat monthly add-ons, and verify the bottom breakdown card changes appropriately.
Test at least one combination of multiple add-ons to look for stacking, ordering, or total-calculation issues.
exit_criteria: The calculation disclosure has been opened successfully.
Add-on selections visibly affect the breakdown or quote state, and multi-add-on combinations do not break layout or totals.

phases.title: Tier explainer, feature matrix, and FAQ
phases.objective: Check the deeper informational sections for interactive mapping and layout integrity.
key_checks: Click each of the tier explainer cells to confirm the corresponding tier highlight/state changes as expected.
Scan the feature comparison table for readability and any missing alignment or truncation issues.
Interact with the FAQ items if they are expandable, verifying open/close behavior and content completeness.
exit_criteria: The tier mapping interaction has been validated for multiple tiers.
The feature comparison and FAQ sections have been inspected for interaction or layout defects.

phases.title: Responsive/mobile verification
phases.objective: Repeat the most important pricing and navigation interactions in mobile viewport, focusing on tap-target and layout risks.
key_checks: Re-check the header navigation and primary CTA on the landing page for tap usability.
Repeat at least one matrix selection, one add-on toggle, and the calculation expander on pricing.html in mobile viewport.
Look for clipping, overflow, sticky-card obstruction, and any controls that become too small or hard to tap.
exit_criteria: Critical pricing interactions have been confirmed in mobile viewport.
Any tap-target or layout issues are documented with page and control specificity.

coverage_targets.features: exercise the landing CTA, top navigation, pricing matrix, sticky quote card, calculation expander, add-on checkboxes, tier explainer, feature comparison, and FAQ
coverage_targets.mobile: repeat the pricing matrix selection, add-on toggles, and disclosure interaction on a mobile viewport, while checking header/CTA tap targets

notes: Prioritize the matrix and add-on math over placeholder nav links, but still record whether placeholder links are inert or misleading.
Because the prescan already showed multiple small tap targets, mobile checks should explicitly capture any usability regressions rather than treating them as incidental.
